account.signup.label: New user registration
account.signup.description: A new user account was registered.

notify.body_template: A new account was registered with email {email}.

newsletter.signup.label: Newsletter signup
newsletter.signup.description: Someone subscribed to a mailing list / newsletter.

notify.body_template: A user subscribed to the "{mailing_list_name}" mailing list.

comment.posted.label: New comment posted
comment.posted.description: A new comment was posted on a blog post.

payload.comment_excerpt: Comment body excerpt (truncated at the call site)

secret.unreadable.label: Sealed secret unreadable
secret.unreadable.description: A stored secret (a credential, token, or signing key) cannot be decrypted with this install's key — most often because the database was moved to a machine without the matching secret_box_key, or the key was rotated. Raised once when a secret goes dead, not on every reconcile.

payload.label: Human name of the affected secret (or a batch summary)
payload.count: How many secrets this alert covers
payload.link: Admin surface to act on it
payload.recipients: Admin user ids to notify (the in-system leg must always land)

notify.body_template: {feature}: a stored secret cannot be decrypted here. Re-enter it, or acknowledge a re-mint, on the secrets health page.
